releases.name: qwenpaw-plugin v0.2.2
releases.body:
MemoryLake as a QwenPaw memory backend plugin (`memory-memorylake`), release 0.2.2.

## Install

```
qwenpaw plugin install https://github.com/memorylake-ai/memorylake-harness/releases/download/qwenpaw-plugin-v0.2.2/memory-memorylake-0.2.2.zip
```

Upgrading from 0.2.x: install over the old version and restart QwenPaw (the backend cannot be hot-reloaded while an Agent is using it). Agent settings are kept.

Then, per Agent, in the Console: Agent settings → Memory backend → MemoryLake. See [qwenpaw-plugin/README.md](https://github.com/memorylake-ai/memorylake-harness/blob/main/qwenpaw-plugin/README.md).

Requires QwenPaw ≥ 2.2.1, < 3.0.0.

## Fixed in 0.2.2

Follows memorylake CLI v20261009 (#26):

- **Conversation sync on a fresh install.** CLI v20261009 removed `actor create --type`, so creating the Agent's ASSISTANT actor failed with "unexpected argument" and no turns were synced. Installs that had already created the actor were unaffected.
- **Document excerpts in recall.** Search now returns paragraph, table and NL2SQL matches in `highlight.chunks`; the renderer reads them, so file hits show their excerpts again instead of only the file name.

Built with QwenPaw's `scripts/pack/generate_plugin_metadata.py` from commit ed74f90. The `.sha256` file holds the archive checksum. Checked with `qwenpaw plugin validate`.

releases.body:
MemoryLake as a QwenPaw memory backend plugin (`memory-memorylake`), release 0.2.1.

## Install

```
qwenpaw plugin install https://github.com/memorylake-ai/memorylake-harness/releases/download/qwenpaw-plugin-v0.2.1/memory-memorylake-0.2.1.zip
```

Upgrading from 0.2.0: install over the old version and restart QwenPaw (the backend cannot be hot-reloaded while an Agent is using it). Agent settings are kept.

Then, per Agent, in the Console: Agent settings → Memory backend → MemoryLake. See [qwenpaw-plugin/README.md](https://github.com/memorylake-ai/memorylake-harness/blob/main/qwenpaw-plugin/README.md).

Requires QwenPaw ≥ 2.2.1, < 3.0.0.

## Fixed in 0.2.1

- **Conversation sync on a fresh CLI login.** Every append failed with "no workspace given and none remembered" when the `memorylake` CLI profile had no remembered workspace (a fresh `memorylake auth login`, before `memorylake workspace use`), and turns stayed pending. Appends now pass the Agent's configured workspace (#20).

releases.name: qwenpaw-plugin v0.2.0
releases.body:
MemoryLake as a QwenPaw memory backend plugin (`memory-memorylake`), release 0.2.0.

## Install

```
qwenpaw plugin install https://github.com/memorylake-ai/memorylake-harness/releases/download/qwenpaw-plugin-v0.2.0/memory-memorylake-0.2.0.zip
```

Upgrading from 0.1.0: install over the old version and restart QwenPaw (the backend cannot be hot-reloaded while an Agent is using it). Existing Agent settings are kept; conversation sync is off until you switch it on.

Then, per Agent, in the Console: Agent settings → Memory backend → MemoryLake. See [qwenpaw-plugin/README.md](https://github.com/memorylake-ai/memorylake-harness/blob/main/qwenpaw-plugin/README.md).

Requires QwenPaw ≥ 2.2.1, < 3.0.0.

## New in 0.2.0

- **Conversation sync (opt-in).** Every N user turns (configurable, 1–20), the session's user and assistant text is appended to a MemoryLake conversation through the `memorylake` CLI, one conversation per QwenPaw session, an `ASSISTANT` actor per Agent. MemoryLake then extracts facts from it. Text only: tool calls, tool results and thinking never leave the host. Failed appends are retried on the next batch. Requires a project; the Console form offers a project picker, a switch and the interval.
- **Search playbook in the system prompt.** The memory section now teaches the model when to call `memory_search`, how to write a query (the user's language first, statement keywords, pronouns resolved, absolute dates, one topic per query), how to read results, and that an empty result means "nothing stored", not "you never told me". Tuned against a live QwenPaw.
- **Better automatic recall query.** Recall searches with the whole user message (QwenPaw's default keeps 50 characters) and skips slash commands and filler turns.
- **Tool hardening.** `memory_search` tolerates argument shapes borrowed from `recall_history` and corrects them in the result; an empty call gets an error naming the right shape.
- Brand written as MemoryLake throughout.

Built with QwenPaw's `scripts/pack/generate_plugin_metadata.py` from commit 92e185b. The `.sha256` file holds the archive checksum. Checked with `qwenpaw plugin validate`.

releases.name: qwenpaw-plugin v0.1.0
releases.body:
Memory Lake as a QwenPaw memory backend plugin (`memory-memorylake`), first release.

## Install

```
qwenpaw plugin install https://github.com/memorylake-ai/memorylake-harness/releases/download/qwenpaw-plugin-v0.1.0/memory-memorylake-0.1.0.zip
```

Then, per Agent, in the Console: Agent settings → Memory backend → Memory Lake. On a machine already set up for another Memory Lake harness the form can stay empty. See [qwenpaw-plugin/README.md](https://github.com/memorylake-ai/memorylake-harness/blob/main/qwenpaw-plugin/README.md).

Requires QwenPaw ≥ 2.2.1, < 3.0.0.

## What it does

- Fills QwenPaw's per-Agent memory backend slot: automatic recall before every reply, `memory_search` / `memory_remember` / `memory_forget`, the Memory Lake memory protocol in the system prompt
- Supplies the `memorylake` CLI itself when the host has none (SHA-256 verified download)
- Logs in per Agent inside an isolated directory, never touching the machine's own `~/.memorylake` login; with no API key it reuses the shared login and `config.md`
- Console form with a deployment select, a link to the matching console for the key, and workspace/actor pickers
- `/memorylake-status` diagnostics

Built with QwenPaw's `scripts/pack/generate_plugin_metadata.py` from commit 1e0c886. The `.sha256` file holds the archive checksum.
